timing: Before formal calibration, development fitting or evaluation; after byte retention and prior disclosed raw-outcome exposure.

clarifications.empirical_count: The Jeffreys-0.5 smoothed count template supplies both secondary count TV and binned log loss. The primary mass template remains unsmoothed.
clarifications.coverage_denominator: Positive finite source masses constitute raw_count/raw_mass and the coverage denominators. Missing, unparseable, nonfinite and nonpositive CSV records are separately retained and counted in membership; coverage does not imply those have known mass.
clarifications.likelihood: Continuous likelihood for recorded masses is an approximation; rounding is simulated as a sensitivity, not imposed on source values. Finite count_log_shares remain valid under probability underflow; only true log-zero yields flagged infinite loss.
clarifications.optimizer: Pareto bounded scalar success required. Weibull 12 starts: shapes0.3,0.8,1.5,3.5 crossed with pooled development log-mass quantiles0.25,0.5,0.75; L-BFGS-B maxiter600 ftol1e-12 gtol1e-7. Only successful finite optimizations can be selected; no initial-start fallback.
clarifications.null_envelope: Synthetic 95% IID-envelope threshold is computed against the unrounded log-neutral expected-stock template, matching descriptive scoring. Exact rounded expectations are retained separately to quantify measurement/ratio bias.
